dedupe_keys.name: mozambique agricultural statistics maap integrated agricultural survey iai 2020 and 2023 statistical yearbooks and livestock production tables

description: The statistics section of Mozambique's Ministry of Agriculture, Environment and Fisheries (MAAP) publishes the Integrated Agricultural Survey (Inquérito Agrário Integrado, IAI) and related statistics. Read on 2026-09-29: the IAI 2023 report (about 4.5 million farms, 98.3% small, 1.6% medium and 1,131 large; about 6.9 million hectares cultivated by small and medium farms; 5.7% used pesticides, 9.1% chemical fertiliser and 7.7% irrigation; maize on 82.8% of farms; production changes since 2020 by crop and livestock) and the IAI 2020 report (4.3 million farms, 5.5 million hectares, access to extension, prices and credit); agricultural statistics yearbooks for 2012-2014 and 2015; administrative tables of beef, pork, small ruminant, milk and egg production for 2007 to 2017 (XLS); and a food and nutrition security page linking the IPC analysis of acute food insecurity for April 2024 to March 2025. Coverage: national, Mozambique, with provincial breakdowns in the reports. Format and access: PDF reports and XLS tables in Portuguese, free. Licence: not stated. Caveats: survey reports, not microdata; the livestock tables stop in 2017. Simulation uses: food supply resilience and irrigation capacity planning under drought and cyclone scenarios. Related records: complements the MozFields 2023 field delineations (data-mozfields-2023-mozambique-field-delineations).
